title: Avatar Maker
fullDescription: As the sole developer for this project, my goal was to create a lightweight and highly reusable WebGL avatar maker. The core functionality involved allowing users to create custom avatars that could then be baked into an optimized format and exported as GLB files, making them easily loadable across various platforms and projects. This avatar maker was successfully integrated into three distinct projects: the LandRocker universe, the Alef game, and the Du Fan Zone for FIFA 2022, showcasing its adaptability and ease of integration. It features both male and female base models and is designed to run smoothly even on mobile devices. Leveraging Unity's Addressable Assets system, the avatar maker efficiently loads and unloads a wide range of customization options, from character features and clothing to specific attributes and UI icons, ensuring optimal performance. For the Alef game integration, the avatar maker would bake the final avatar, create an optimized GLB version, export and upload it, then redirect the user to the game where a custom loader would handle the GLB file. I also managed a team of 10 artists to create over 100 diverse assets, ensuring they were all compatible and contributed to a comprehensive and engaging avatar creation experience.

process.title: Sole Development in WebGL
process.description: Developed the entire avatar maker as the sole developer, focusing on creating a lightweight and efficient application using WebGL.

process.title: Avatar Baking and GLB Export Implementation

process.title: Ensuring Reusability and Mobile Compatibility
process.description: Designed the avatar maker with reusability in mind, ensuring it could be easily integrated into multiple projects, and optimized its performance for mobile devices.

process.title: Addressable Assets System Integration
